title: Expected product of the $ab$ and $ca$ votes
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function. For a profile $p$ that assigns each of the $n$ voters one of the six strict orderings of the three alternatives $a,b,c$, let $x^{ab}(p)\in\{0,1\}^n$ record each voter's preference in the $a$-vs-$b$ comparison and let $x^{ca}(p)\in\{0,1\}^n$ record each voter's preference in the $c$-vs-$a$ comparison. Averaging uniformly over all $6^n$ profiles, the expected product of $f$ at these two vote vectors equals the Fourier correlation function of $f$:
\[
  \Bigl(\tfrac{1}{6}\Bigr)^{n}\sum_{p} f\bigl(x^{ab}(p)\bigr)\,f\bigl(x^{ca}(p)\bigr)
  \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \hat f(S)^{2}\,(-1/3)^{|S|}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued Boolean function on {0,1}^n
